Optimized FP32 EEGNet forward pass. Spatial/temporal linear layers are fused; ELU and pooling remain in the correct nonlinear order. Uses BN-folded weights.
EEGNet OWN input conditioning: 8-channel common-average reference followed by four second-order bandpass sections at 250 Hz.
Streaming 8-channel circular window, gap detection, warm-up, per-channel z-score and hop scheduling. Free-running, with no trial reset/gating.

Generated model architecture constants and learned weights. Replace via a compatible exporter, not by editing individual floating-point values. This snapshot identifies the P04 two-class ME checkpoint.
PlatformIO board/build environments. Current default targets ESP32-S3, Arduino framework, PSRAM and 4 MB flash.
Hardware driver: SPI/register commands, chip verification, acquisition mode and DMA reads. It converts ADC wire bytes into signed channel counts; it does not classify fingers.
Rolling analysis windows, Goertzel spectral power and SSVEP reference/background calculations. Used in higher stages, not by the Stage 7 EEGNet model path.
CCA-based SSVEP scores via covariance, matrix inversion/regularization and power iteration, then shaped feedback. Not finger EEGNet.
Non-blocking per-sample preprocessing/window creation plus a queued inference task on Core 1. Sends only winning class, confidence, latency and newest-sample sequence.
Standard board conditioner: clamps, DC blocker, 61-tap FIR, gradient/glitch gate. Distinct from EEGNet OWN preprocessing.
Owns Wi-Fi/TCP and the transmit task. Handles marker commands/echoes, batching, reconnects, stream selection, health reports and optional replay injection.
Legacy spectral SMI/SSVEP feedback with baseline/scaling/median smoothing. It is a different algorithm from finger EEGNet.
Serializes framed TCP packets. Header: AA55, frame type, 32-bit sequence, 16-bit payload length; little endian. No CRC is added by these builders.
Optional queued binary raw recording to SD. Conditional on LOG_DEST; unrelated to Unity files in Android persistentDataPath.
Owns shared ring buffers, counters, processing flag and marker latch. Allocates the processed ring in PSRAM before producer/consumer tasks start.
Board entry point. Compile-time stages select which code exists in the firmware. Setup creates tasks; live acquisition, processing, inference and networking then run concurrently.
Python telemetry GUI; the shared Unity CalibrationScreen provides the corresponding in-app UI.

Optional PC receiver/parser/logger for board frames. An alternative to Unity BciCore as TCP receiver, not an extra receiver on the same port.
PC validation/replay tool. Maps CSV columns to board channels, sends synthetic RAW frames to port 5007 and prepares truth labels. Not a training or weight exporter.
Compares emitted model predictions with replay ground truth. Does not train or modify weights.
